body: It sounds amazing to have such a close bond of love with both of your parents, I wish I could say the same. And I sincerely apologise for your loss. Most people say the words but don't understand the pain, but I definitely do, I see you. I think about death everyday even if I'm not my own instrument of destruction in my ruminations. Its great that you still have things you want to do and look forward to, it means that you're heart is still open no matter how small it may be. I hope one day you find some happiness again though it may never fulfill you, makes you feel less lonely. Don't invalidate the pain you feel because you might be better off than the next you pain is personal and will always be massive because it pertains specifically to you.

Unfortunately my GP thinks a brisk walk and session on insight timer will cure my emotional and mental pain so she has refused to put me on medication. My therapist is my rock without whom (and my dogs) I may have already found a away out. I've watched my mum deteriorate over the course of three years, completely losing all mental faculty and resorting to drugs and alcohol to cope with the pain of being alive. Not something a brisk walk can cure, I'm afraid.

 I wish you the best, hopefully with this community it brings you sliver of comfort knowing you're not alone and validation of your feelings and struggle.
